plainText:
Emlyn McFarland (born Emlyn Elisabeth Williams Morinelli), is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of . She is sometimes credited as Emlyn Morinelli, Elisabeth Williams, Anna Morrow, or Emily Williams. She is currently affiliated with Innovative Artists.

==Pokémon roles==
McFarland joined when and TAJ Productions took over the dubbing and distribution of the series. Her most prominent roles are that of Zoey and Officer Jenny. She didn't provide any more voices in the series after the fifteenth season. However, after a long absence, she finally returned in Pokémon Ultimate Journeys: The Series.
